title: VENUS — THE FORBIDDEN LOVE · treyler (50 s)

musiqa.prompt:
Epic cinematic movie trailer score, about 50 seconds long. Instrumental only, no vocals, no lyrics. Sci-fi romance: two worlds, a forbidden love between a Venusian prince and an Earth girl, mood and colors like the attached poster (gold, violet, deep space).
[0:00 - 0:07] Intro: vast ethereal space atmosphere, shimmering high strings, soft wordless-free synth pads, a distant deep boom.
[0:07 - 0:17] Mystery: low pulsing strings and a slow heartbeat drum, a gentle haunting piano motif.
[0:17 - 0:25] Rising tension: ostinato strings accelerate, taiko hits, brass swells.
[0:25 - 0:33] Impact: massive braam hits, full percussion, a short silence then a huge hit.
[0:33 - 0:44] Climax: full epic orchestra and choir-like synth (no words), the romantic main theme soaring with brass and strings.
[0:44 - 0:50] Ending: one final powerful hit, then the piano motif alone, fading out softly.
